title: Red Armor
wikitext:
'''Protection:''' 80% of the damage

'''Red Armor''' ('''RA''') is one of three [[Armor|Armors]] found in the game. This will bring your Armor to 200.  It is also the strongest armor, it will absorb most of the damage, and will not impact the health very much, allowing the player to replenish the damage more fully with health boxes.

It is often one of the primary control points of a map.
